content:
In the chaos of reality,
I stand before the divine shrine.
Closing my eyes,
I gather that sacred form within.
Slowly, I drift
Away from the noise of the world.
A gentle breeze…
Caresses my cheeks,
An invisible touch—
Soft, yet profound,
Whispering of something unseen,
Something eternal.
My soul resonates
In that silent communion…
And I find myself smiling,
Without knowing why.
